common: Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics, no spoken words. Dark cinematic night-siege tower defense game soundtrack: East Asian wuxia fantasy fused with a modern hybrid orchestra and a subtle electronic pulse. No gayageum folk plucking lead, no festive samulnori. Starts immediately, steady energy, loop friendly, no fade out.

tracks.bgm_lobby: Moonlit night-watch camp main menu theme: soft felt piano and a solo piri reed melody over a low warm synth pad, one distant temple bell, calm but watchful, D minor, 72 BPM.
tracks.bgm_dustyYard: Midnight raid on a mountain village: driving low cello ostinato, frame drums, sharp bowed ajaeng accents, rising tension, E minor, 112 BPM.
tracks.bgm_oilyTable: Sneaking night creatures around a granary and harbor: pizzicato strings, wood blocks, marimba pattern, low clarinet melody, mischievous but dangerous, G minor, 104 BPM.
tracks.bgm_turtleMarket: Night market under siege: pulsing analog synth bass with huge war drums and short brass swells, urgent defense, A minor, 126 BPM.
tracks.bgm_kubiForest: Beacon fortress in a dark pine forest: hollow ocarina-like clay flute, slow heartbeat taiko, tremolo strings in mist, ominous, C minor, 96 BPM.
tracks.bgm_logicMarble: Clockwork trap mechanisms at night: precise ticking percussion, hammered dulcimer arpeggios, interlocking synth sequence and staccato strings, F sharp minor, 118 BPM.
tracks.bgm_murimIce: Frozen two-front battle under the moon: glassy bells and celesta, wide cold string chords, martial snare and deep drum march, B minor, 108 BPM.
tracks.bgm_clash: Volcanic sealed temple battle: aggressive low brass, anvil strikes, distorted synth bass, relentless drums, D phrygian, 138 BPM.
tracks.bgm_boss: Final midnight boss siege: full epic orchestra, thunderous war drums, fast string ostinato, heroic French horn theme against dark choir-like synth pads without any voices, C sharp minor, 150 BPM.
